user.title: Connect Duke Energy usage
user.description: Version {version}. Choose the cumulative kWh statistic imported by the official Duke Energy integration. This calculator does not need your Duke Energy credentials.

data_description.source_statistic: Cumulative kWh statistic imported by the official Duke Energy integration.
data_description.name: Name used for the device and its sensors.
data_description.schedule: Rate schedule printed on the Duke Energy bill.
data_description.billing_cycle_day: Day of the month, from 1 to 28, when fixed charges and monthly totals reset.
data_description.currency: Currency symbol used by the generated cost statistics. Duke Energy bills normally use USD.
data_description.three_phase: Enable only if the account is billed for three-phase residential service.

rates.title: Rates and adjustments
rates.description: Published {schedule} values are prefilled. Review them against a recent bill. Energy rates and riders are currency units/kWh; sales tax is a percentage (enter 7 for 7%).

data_description.basic_charge: Fixed amount charged once per billing cycle, in USD.
data_description.three_phase_charge: Additional fixed amount per billing cycle when three-phase service is enabled, in USD.
data_description.summer_rate: RES energy price for May through September, in USD/kWh.
data_description.winter_first_rate: RES energy price for the first winter tier from October through April, in USD/kWh.
data_description.winter_additional_rate: RES energy price above the winter first-tier threshold, in USD/kWh.
data_description.tier_kwh: RES winter kWh included in the first tier during each billing cycle.
data_description.on_peak_rate: Energy price during the schedule's on-peak windows, in USD/kWh.
data_description.off_peak_rate: Energy price during off-peak windows, in USD/kWh.
data_description.discount_rate: Energy price during the lowest-price discount windows, in USD/kWh.
data_description.critical_peak_rate: R-TOU-CPP energy price during a configured critical-peak event, in USD/kWh.
data_description.standard_rate: R-TOU-EV energy price outside discount windows, in USD/kWh.
data_description.on_peak_demand_rate: R-TOUD charge for the billing-cycle on-peak demand, in USD/kW.
data_description.max_demand_rate: R-TOUD charge for the billing-cycle maximum demand, in USD/kW.
data_description.demand_mode: Choose an hourly estimate, manual billed kW values, or no demand charges.
data_description.manual_on_peak_kw: Billed monthly on-peak demand in kW. Used only with the manual demand method.
data_description.manual_max_kw: Billed monthly maximum demand in kW. Used only with the manual demand method.
data_description.cpp_events: Announced event dates separated by commas or new lines. Add @HH to override the event start hour.
data_description.additional_kwh_rate: Combined usage-based riders or adjustments, in USD/kWh. Enter 0 when none are needed.
data_description.monthly_adjustment: Fixed amount added once per billing cycle, in USD. Use a negative value for a credit.
data_description.tax_percent: Percentage applied to energy, riders, fixed charges, and demand charges. Enter 7 for 7%.

error.invalid_energy_statistic: Select a sum statistic measured in kWh.
error.invalid_cpp_events: Use comma- or line-separated YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD@HH entries.

abort.already_configured: This Duke Energy consumption statistic is already configured.
